finite_specialization_correction.verdict: Pass, bounded independent review; no full workspace or native rerun by reviewer

normative_basis.rule: Definition-time bound/capability checks remain mandatory even for unused templates. For this finite profile, ordinary T is concretized before F instantiation and the complete actual body/result/bound is checked again. A symbolic U is not a universal promise that it differs from i32, nor must the unused template prove all future substitutions inject uniquely. Determined T!T and an actually equal instantiated union still reject.

finite_specialization_correction.reviewer_correction: The reviewer incorrectly promoted potential future equality in an unused symbolic template to a definition-time bug. That enlarged the contract and caused two existing legal CI programs to reject. The original baa Pass verdict did not establish compatibility. This section explicitly retracts that interpretation without deleting observed failures.
